content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks online

This post is about the real architecture behind selling ebooks online without relying on PayPal or other platforms that exclude certain countries. It's about creating a permanent structural alternative at the base layer, not a workaround or a temporary fix. The goal is to empower creators to take control of their digital commerce stacks, free from the restrictions imposed by third-party platforms.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture is built around a sovereign digital commerce stack, comprising free and paid tools that give creators a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This stack is deployed on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 is used for file delivery, and NOWPayments handles automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with a 0.5% fee.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
This solution is not a workaround or a temporary fix, but a permanent structural alternative at the base layer.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign digital commerce stack is comprised of the following components: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Each component is carefully selected to provide a seamless and secure payment processing experience for creators.
